configurationNotes: GPIO25 is a static LCD power enable; do not keep PWM5 mapped to this pin.
Explicitly select GPIO9 for PWMG0 channel3; GPIO23 is an alternate location and must not remain mapped for this board.
Release unused UART1/SDIO/SPI0/other alternate functions on GPIO1/14/15/25/28 before configuring ordinary GPIO.
Preserve SPI1 on GPIO2/3/4, UART0 on GPIO10/11, and all analog interfaces.
Preserve active levels: LCD enable high, reset low, backlight low, amplifier enable high, shutdown high.
PWMG0 channels2 and3 share a counter; leave channel2 disabled unless its waveform requirements are compatible with backlight PWM3. This is unrelated to SPI1 GPIO2.
